insights.summary: Alphabet delivered strong full-year 2025 results with revenues of $402.8B (+15% YoY) and net income of $132.2B (+32% YoY), driven by growth across Google Services, Google Cloud (+36%), and subscription businesses. The company is significantly accelerating capex investments to $91.4B (+74% YoY) for AI infrastructure while maintaining 32% operating margins, but faces substantial regulatory headwinds including DOJ antitrust remedies, EU fines, and evolving AI/data protection regulations globally. Management projects material increases in 2026 capex relative to 2025 for technical infrastructure despite robust operating cash flow of $164.7B.
keyQuotes: In 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers.

The costs associated with operating our technical infrastructure - depreciation, energy, equipment, and network capacity - are expected to significantly increase as developing and serving AI offerings require more compute power than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings.

In December 2025, entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Wiz, a leading cloud security platform, for $32.0 billion, and Intersect, a provider of data center and energy infrastructure solutions, for $4.8 billion in cash plus the assumption of debt.
